security_and_auth.administrator_model: Single configured administrator account (zero public self-registration)
security_and_auth.session_management: Cryptographic JWT tokens (HS256) with configurable expiration (120 min)
security_and_auth.global_session_invalidation: Monotonic auth_version increment on password reset
security_and_auth.brute_force_protection: Progressive lockout (5 failed attempts locks client for 15 minutes)
security_and_auth.error_masking: Constant generic message 'Invalid email or password' (prevents account enumeration)
security_and_auth.password_reset_tokens: Single-use cryptographic URL-safe tokens (32 bytes); only SHA-256 hash stored
security_and_auth.resource_access_control: Streamlit st.stop() halts unauthenticated UI rendering; FastAPI get_current_admin dependency returns 401
